recipes.name: Margaritas inspired by Archer
instructions: In a cocktail glass, fill to the brim with ice and add 4 parts margarita mix to 1 part tequila. - Pre made Margarita Sour Mix - Tequila - Ice
Stir using a bar spoon or any stirring utensil until everything is fully incorporated.

If a salted rim is preferred, start by cutting a lime in half then rubbing the lime on the rim of the glass before dipping glass down into kosher salt. - freshly squeezed lime juice - Salt for garnish (optional)
In a shaker, add agave tequila, Cointreau, and freshly squeezed lime juice. - 3 oz agave tequila - 1 ½ oz Cointreau - 1 ½ oz freshly squeezed lime juice
Pour into a shaker and shake vigorously before pouring into the salt-rimmed glass full of ice. - Ice
Garnish with a slice of lime on the side of the glass. - Limes for garnish (optional)
